newsitem.title: USA: U.S. BULK MILLFEEDS-PRICES MOSTLY STEADY TO HIGHER.
newsitem.headline: U.S. BULK MILLFEEDS-PRICES MOSTLY STEADY TO HIGHER.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were mostly steady to higher on Wednesday as dealers in several locations across the United States noted more interest in the deferred positions.
Prices on wheat middlings were little changed in the Kansas/Oklahoma market from last week's quote, a Kansas dealer said.
"The only thing the (CBOT) corn runup did was raise the deferred offers," he said.
He referred to a CBOT December corn rally on Tuesday linked to a bullish USDA crop report.
"Midds are up with the CBOT board," a St Louis dealer said.
He said that a lot more people were inquiring about the forwards after the USDA report.
"People were examining midds as a value and I don't think they were doing that before this report came out," he said.
In the northeast U.S., nearby supplies remained tight.
"We continue to have enough of a slowdown in runtime that keeps supplies very tight. I am looking for something today and I have not been able to find a truckload," a dealer there said.
